content:
Maya (Growth): Morning team — want to run a small experiment for next week's webinar promo. 'Pulsewave' social arc: staggered X threads + LinkedIn carousel, seed with warm list, quick followups. Goal: 250 signups, + benchmark narrative for latency/cost angle. :rocket:

Leo (Content): Love it. Do we have a hero image and short variant captions? I can draft 3 thread openers + 2 LinkedIn slides. Need assets by EOD today. :art:

Priya (Demand): UTM and seed list? I'll pull last quarter's highest-engaging 1k users. Prefer we route inbound leads to SDRs with high-intent tag "pulsewave_webinar". Also want a short 1-line benefit we can A/B test: "Cut inference cost by 2x" vs "Ship LLM features with predictable latency".

Sam (Ops): Tentative schedule I recommend: X thread 1 (tease) Wed 09:30 PT, X thread 2 (reminder) Thu 10:00 PT, LinkedIn carousel Thu 10:15 PT, final push Fri 08:30 PT. Seed DMs for high-priority accounts 1 hour after each post. Will open drafts in Buffer and set approvals. :calendar:

Maya (Growth): Good — seed DMs only for accounts in the warm list (Priya will mark). Also want the first X thread to end with a CTA to short registration form (1 field). Keep the sign-up link short and trackable.

Leo (Content): Draft copy snippets:
1) "We built a production inference stack for teams who need predictable latency. Join our webinar to see the tradeoffs and real numbers."
2) "Worried about inference cost? We'll show configurations that reduce token costs with no quality loss. Wed demo."

Priya (Demand): I'll add UTMs like utm_campaign=pulsewave&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_content=teaseA and generate a seeded short link: https://rwd.ai/pulsewave?t=teaseA. SDR Team — can you confirm capacity for followups if we hit 300 signups? @SDR Team

SDR Team: capacity check: we can handle 200 immediate outreach. If >200, prioritize accounts flagged as "enterprise" and the top 100 by engagement score. We'll stand by. :white_check_mark:

Sam (Ops): Put the canonical schedule as CSV so we can import to scheduler:```
platform,datetime_iso,copy_variant,asset,link,utm
X,2026-04-08T16:30:00Z,"teaseA","hero_v2.png","https://rwd.ai/pulsewave?t=teaseA","utm_campaign=pulsewave&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_content=teaseA"
X,2026-04-09T17:00:00Z,"reminderB","hero_v2_alt.png","https://rwd.ai/pulsewave?t=remindB","utm_campaign=pulsewave&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_content=remindB"
LinkedIn,2026-04-09T17:15:00Z,"carouselA","carousel_assets.zip","https://rwd.ai/pulsewave","utm_campaign=pulsewave&utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social"
```

Leo (Content): Asset ask: want final hero (1200x628) + high-res slide PNGs + 1 short gif (6s) showing latency chart. Can someone drop files to the marketing drive and ping me?

Maya (Growth): Drive link: https://drive.redwood/marketing/pulsewave (draft). Drop final files there and tag @Leo. Also add a single-row tracking sheet: https://sheets.redwood/pulsewave-tracking. Everyone please add the copy variant you'll own.

Priya (Demand): I'll push the seeded email to the warm list right after the first X tease. Subject test A/B: "Demo: predictable LLM inference" vs "See how teams cut inference costs".

Leo (Content): Quick note on tone: keep it engineering-forward but approachable. Short bullets in the thread for the benchmarking claims: runtime (p95), cost/token improvements, and an example customer workload. Don't use too many superlatives.

Maya (Growth): Engagement ops — ask crew to like/retweet within 1 hour of X posts. We'll run a 3-hour engagement window and collect replies into the tracking sheet. Sam, can you set up a pulse for replies flagged as signups?

Sam (Ops): Yep — will create alert in the console and forward any reply containing "register" or the short link to the tracker. Also enabling a 15-min buffer to batch DMs so SDRs aren't overwhelmed.

MarketingBot: Drafts saved to Buffer: 3 X posts, 1 LinkedIn carousel. Reminder scheduled for approvals at 18:00 PT. Analytics tags added: campaign=pulsewave.

Maya (Growth): Final asks before EOD: Leo — upload assets. Priya — seed list + short link. Sam — scheduler import + DM flow. SDR Team — confirm contact prioritization doc is shared. We'll reconvene 08:30 PT tomorrow for a 15-min pre-launch check. :thumbsup:

Leo (Content): Will upload in 45m.

Priya (Demand): Seed list done in 20m, short links queued.

SDR Team: Prioritization doc shared — https://docs.redwood/sdr/prioritization-pulsewave.

Sam (Ops): Scheduler import ready, I'll run it after Leo uploads assets.

Maya (Growth): Awesome — thanks all. If anything slams, ping me in thread. :sparkles:
